name: library-management-system
description: Monolithic Library Management System - React frontend, NestJS backend, local SQLite database

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
